title: A meeting was held at Bishkek State University

blocks.text: On May 21, 2025, a meeting of deans and heads of departments was held at Bishkek State University named after K. Karasayev. During the event, issues of preventing violations of discipline and manifestations of corruption during the final session, as well as preparation for the admission of students for the new academic year and improving the work of the admissions committee were discussed.
In addition, on behalf of Rector Mirlan Dyldaev, Dean of the Faculty of Kyrgyz Philology Kanybek Kenzheshev presented strategic plans for the development of the faculty for 2025–2030.
Following the meeting, appropriate recommendations were given for the timely and high-quality completion of assigned tasks and the implementation of strategic plans.
